title: Refund Policy — Wheel of Names
description: When Wheel of Names refunds a paid plan, how to request one, what happens to the plan after a refund and where the request is sent.
heroText: This page states when a charge for a plan is refunded, how to ask for one and what changes once it is approved. The free wheel needs no refund.

ctas.label: Request a refund through the form

sections.title: When a plan is refunded
sections.body: A request made within 14 days of a charge is refunded in full. After 14 days, a refund is not automatic. Write anyway if something went wrong on the site's side and the case is looked at individually.

sections.title: How to ask
sections.body: Send the request through the form on the [contact page](/contact/) with the plan name, the date of the charge and, if you have it, the checkout receipt reference. The plan's price and term are listed on the [pricing page](/pricing/).

steps.title: Choose the billing subject
steps.body: Pick the billing option in the form so the message lands with the charge it concerns.

steps.title: Add the charge details
steps.body: Plan name, date and receipt reference are enough to match the payment to the right account.

steps.title: Read the decision
steps.body: The decision comes back in the same message thread, and an approved refund returns to the original payment method.

sections.title: After a refund
sections.body: A refunded plan ends. Saved wheels and draw records beyond the free use stop loading, so export or note what you need before the request is approved. A one-time pass stops at the end of the refunded period rather than at its planned end date.

sections.title: Free use
sections.body: Nothing on the free wheel is charged, so there is nothing to refund. If a charge appears on your statement for an account you do not recognise, send the details through the form and it is investigated before anything else is done.

faq.question: How long does a refund take to arrive?
faq.answer: An approved refund is sent to the payment processor within two working days of the decision. How quickly it shows on a statement depends on the card issuer, which usually posts it within five to ten business days. The processor's own receipt is the record to quote if it does not appear.

faq.question: What if I bought a yearly plan by mistake?
faq.answer: Send the request within 14 days of the charge and the yearly plan is refunded in full, the same as a monthly plan. Ask through the contact form with the plan name and charge date so the plan can be matched to the payment.
